span.p:
Three ML paradigms · §1
supervised: input–output pairs · unsupervised: no labels, discover structure · RL: no supervisor, delayed rewards, sequential decisions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
The RL framework · §2–4
agent–environment loop: observe state → take action → get reward + next state · policy π(a|s) · episodic vs continuing

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Markov Decision Process · §5–7
5-tuple (S, A, P, R, γ) · Markov property · discount γ controls the horizon · return Gₜ = Σ γᵏ Rₜ₊ₖ₊₁

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Value functions · §8
Vπ(s): how good is state s? · Qπ(s,a): how good is action a in s? · Vπ(s) = Σ_a π(a|s) Qπ(s,a)

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Bellman equations · §9–12
expectation: Vπ(s) = Σ_a π(a|s)[R + γ Σ P(s'|s,a) Vπ(s')] · optimality: V*(s) = max_a[…] · policy iteration vs value iteration

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: foundation for all RL — Q-learning, DQN, actor–critic, PPO, …
